lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Tread carefully, traveler. Once you cross this gate, the road turns treacherous.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Treacherous? What lies ahead after this castle?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: The Rotten Mire—a stagnant swamp thick with venomous mist and sinking ground.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Worse than the mud, a fearsome warrior guards the deep marsh. He tests the resolve of anyone seeking passage.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: A swamp and a powerful guardian won't stop me. I'm moving forward.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Keep your footing solid and your blade ready. May fortune guide your steps.
